```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

if (dir.exists("D:/RLanguage/R_Packages")) {
  .libPaths(c("D:/RLanguage/R_Packages", .libPaths()))
}

# Project root (works when knitting from reports/ or from the project root)
root <- if (dir.exists("results")) "." else ".."
p <- function(...) file.path(root, ...)

# Show a saved figure inside the HTML file
show_fig <- function(file, caption) {
  path <- p("figures", file)
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    cat(sprintf('<p><img src="%s" style="max-width:100%%;"></p><p><em>%s</em></p>\n',
                knitr::image_uri(path), caption))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("<p><strong>Figure not found: figures/%s (run code/analysis.R first)</strong></p>\n", file))
  }
}

# Read the result files created by analysis.R
read_res <- function(f) {
  x <- read.csv(p("results", f), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (names(x)[1] %in% c("", "X")) names(x)[1] <- "ProbeID"
  x
}

all_de <- read_res("all_differential_expression.csv")
sig    <- read_res("significant_probes.csv")
up     <- read_res("upregulated_probes.csv")
down   <- read_res("downregulated_probes.csv")
ann    <- read_res("annotated_results.csv")
meta   <- read.csv(p("results", "sample_metadata.csv"), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
expr   <- read.csv(p("results", "clean_expression_matrix.csv"), check.names = FALSE, row.names = 1)

n_tested <- nrow(all_de)
n_sig    <- nrow(sig)
n_up     <- nrow(up)
n_down   <- nrow(down)
n_fdr    <- sum(all_de[["adj.P.Val"]] < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

# Top probes with annotation
ann$Locus <- sub("\\|.*$", "", as.character(ann$Accessions))
ann_sig   <- ann[order(ann$P.Value), ]
ann_up    <- ann[ann$logFC > 0, ]
ann_up    <- ann_up[order(-ann_up$logFC), ]
ann_down  <- ann[ann$logFC < 0, ]
ann_down  <- ann_down[order(ann_down$logFC), ]

top_table <- function(d, n = 10) {
  d <- head(d, n)
  data.frame(
    Probe = d$ProbeID,
    Locus = d$Locus,
    logFC = round(d$logFC, 2),
    adj.P = formatC(d[["adj.P.Val"]], format = "e", digits = 2),
    Description = d$Description,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

# 1. Overview

- **Dataset:** NCBI GEO GSE115826, *Oryza sativa* shoot, day 3, platform GPL6864 (Agilent 4x44K).
- **Samples:** 4 control and 4 drought arrays.
- **Method:** limma (linear model + empirical Bayes), Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment.
- **Comparison:** Drought - Control (positive logFC = higher in drought).
- **Significance rule:** adjusted P < 0.05 and |logFC| >= 1.

# 2. Samples

```{r samples}
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    GEO_accession = meta$geo_accession,
    Title = meta$title,
    Condition = meta$condition
  )
)
```

# 3. Data preparation (as done in analysis.R)

- The GEO series matrix values are the Agilent Feature Extraction LogRatio (log10 of Cy5/Cy3).
- Probes with missing or infinite values, and probes with zero variance, were removed.
- The values were multiplied by log2(10) to convert them to the log2 scale.
- Probes on the original series matrix: 45,151. Probes analysed: `r format(n_tested, big.mark = ",")`.

# 4. Exploratory data analysis

## Per-sample summary

```{r sample-stats}
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Sample = colnames(expr),
    Group = meta$condition[match(colnames(expr), meta$geo_accession)],
    Mean = round(colMeans(expr), 3),
    SD = round(apply(expr, 2, sd), 3),
    Min = round(apply(expr, 2, min), 2),
    Max = round(apply(expr, 2, max), 2)
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Figures

```{r eda-figs, results='asis'}
show_fig("sample_distribution.png", "Figure 1. Samples per group.")
show_fig("expression_boxplot.png", "Figure 2. Expression distribution per sample.")
show_fig("mds_plot.png", "Figure 3. MDS plot of the eight samples.")
```

# 5. Differential expression results

```{r counts}
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Category = c("Probes analysed",
                 "Adjusted P < 0.05",
                 "Significant (adj. P < 0.05 and |logFC| >= 1)",
                 "Upregulated",
                 "Downregulated"),
    Probes = format(c(n_tested, n_fdr, n_sig, n_up, n_down), big.mark = ",")
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Top 10 most significant probes

```{r top-sig}
knitr::kable(top_table(ann_sig, 10), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Top 10 upregulated probes (largest logFC)

```{r top-up}
knitr::kable(top_table(ann_up, 10), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Top 10 downregulated probes (smallest logFC)

```{r top-down}
knitr::kable(top_table(ann_down, 10), row.names = FALSE)
```
